snippet.title: AI This Week
snippet.description:
AI news that matters — and why it matters to you.

Every Sunday we cover the week's biggest AI developments worldwide, with a special focus on the Middle East: model launches, investment, regulation and how organisations are putting AI to work. We don't just report what happened; we explain why it's important and what it means for your work, your business and your region.

The twist: your presenter is an AI. Wissam Kishek, an enterprise technology executive with 20+ years across the Middle East and Africa, cloned himself to brief you every week. His digital twin's video and voice are AI-generated; the editorial choices are his. 

Recurring segment — From the Region: one country, one AI development, and what it means.

New episode every Sunday, 8:00 AM Gulf time.
